product_one_liner.value: Luciq is an AI-powered mobile observability platform that helps mobile engineering teams detect, diagnose, prioritize, and resolve app crashes, performance problems, and user-experience issues.

employee_band.notes: The company profile reports 194 employees; headcounts vary across sources.

founded_year.notes: The company profile lists 2014. Origin dates differ: the official history describes the founders starting in 2013, with a 2012 incubator application; PitchBook lists 2012.

eng_blog.notes: Engineering accounts by Khaled Elmorabea and Mohamed Aziz describe Luciq’s SDK architecture rewrite and production ClickHouse/S3 cost optimization, respectively.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live board lists two openings: Enterprise Account Executive and Product Engineer (Backend); neither title meets the specified AI/ML/data-science criterion.

model_provider.notes: SmartResolve documentation names both model families; the current subprocessor list also names OpenAI for AI-powered product features.

compliance_certs.notes: SOC 2 Type II and ISO 27001 are listed as certified; HIPAA and GDPR are compliance claims, not certification schemes.

last_funding.notes: Announced May 17, 2022. PitchBook separately lists an undated private secondary transaction, which does not establish a later capital-raising round.

raised_18mo.notes: The most recent identified funding round precedes the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: Enterprise Account Executive is listed on the current job board.

launched_6mo.notes: Luciq CLI was announced as live on July 22, 2026, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: An August 11, 2026 announcement reports Kenny Johnston joining Azul from Luciq, where he was Chief Product and Technology Officer, establishing a C-level departure within the window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The subprocessor table names Salesforce.com and Totango for customer relations management, Hubspot for marketing automation, and MailChimp as a mail service provider.
